atomicity: Each transition creates a commit whose parent is the previously observed branch HEAD; branch ref update must be fast-forward only. Concurrent stale-parent commits are rejected and must reread/retry.
fencing: Monotonically increasing global fencing token, persisted in the same state commit as lease transition.
canonical_write: Only a worker with the currently valid lease and fencing token may publish; stale tokens are rejected.
fail_closed: On API 403/429/5xx, network error, branch conflict exhaustion, malformed state or unknown quota, do not grant lease; keep task WAITING_FOR_QUOTA/WAITING_FOR_LOCK.
status_note: Dedicated branch initialized; 7 unit/state tests PASS; live GitHub Actions probe with 20 simultaneous contenders produced exactly one lease owner and 19 BUSY exits, released the lease, and verified the 9-event hash chain. No active leases remain. Still a prototype only: no project-cell client, no cross-repo App installation, no 100-way live race, no quota arbiter. Cross-project writes remain disabled.

unit_tests.includes: 100 concurrent contenders against deterministic atomic CAS simulator; exactly one winner
